title: The python-single-package-extras editable fact's anchor quotes the editable or --no-editable sentence, not 'workspaces may be a better fit'
goal: kb/public/_anchors.csv's S1706 row for the arch/python-single-package-extras.md editable fact (key 53e9732a3a3e, lines 37-39) quotes a sentence of uv's dependencies page that the fact asserts (workspace members editable by default, or uv add --no-editable), re-anchored with factdiff.py anchor --quotes, so a change to those sentences shows as a changed fact. Found by the SP-tjap3mdd review (S4).

run: import csv,sys; rs=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_anchors.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['path'].endswith('python-single-package-extras.md') and r['source_id']=='S1706' and r['status']=='located' and 'editable' in r['quote'].lower()]; sys.exit(0 if rs else 1)
